classification.classification_reason: The article is about FIFA's decision to confirm the UK bid for hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup.

content.title: Fifa to Confirm UK Bid for 2035 Women's World Cup
content.caption: Fifa has confirmed the UK bid for hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup, with England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales as the co-hosts.

slides.heading: Fifa to Confirm UK Bid for 2035 Women's World Cup
slides.text: Fifa has confirmed the UK bid for hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup, with England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales as the co-hosts.

slides.heading: Co-hosts for 2035 Women's World Cup
slides.text: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales are the co-hosts for the 2035 Women's World Cup, with 104 matches and 48 teams over 39 days.

slides.heading: Proposed Venues for 2035 Women's World Cup
slides.text: Proposed venues for the 2035 Women's World Cup include 14 venues in England, one in Northern Ireland, two in Scotland, and two in Wales.
